canonical.title: Theming, tokens and brand reach: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI in 2026

parent.title: Which React UI component kit should itenium-ui adopt in 2026?

siblings.title: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI: the 2026 maturity and governance baseline
siblings.summary: The four kits are not the same category: MUI and Mantine are batteries-included libraries, shadcn/ui is a code registry, Base UI is primitives — and as of July 2026 shadcn/ui defaults to Base UI, making MUI's own primitive layer the de-facto industry standard.

siblings.title: Styling engine and Tailwind 4 interop: which React component kit survives the cascade
siblings.summary: Tailwind 4 puts every utility inside a cascade layer, so any kit that ships unlayered CSS silently outranks it — which reframes the MUI/shadcn/Mantine/Base UI choice as a question about where each kit's styles land in the layer stack, and surfaces a bigger Nx @source tax underneath all four.

siblings.title: Admin-console component coverage: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually ship in 2026
siblings.summary: Only Mantine covers a CRUD admin console in-box with a single gap (the data grid); MUI's coverage is real but the grid features you actually need are paywalled; shadcn now defaults to Base UI, making them one choice, not two.

siblings.title: A11y & primitive foundations: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually inherit in 2026
siblings.summary: shadcn-vs-Base-UI is a false dichotomy: since July 2026 shadcn/ui ships Base UI as its default primitive layer, so the real choice is which primitive foundation you inherit — and none of the four kits publishes a VPAT.

siblings.title: Nx 21 build ergonomics: which UI kit survives a shared itenium-ui library
siblings.summary: shadcn/ui's copy-in model does work in a shared Nx library, but only if you own the plumbing: a components.json in the lib, a private registry for updates, and Tailwind 4 @source globs across the boundary.

sources.title: shadcn/ui changelog — Base UI is the default (July 2026)
sources.claim: As of July 2026 shadcn/ui defaults new projects to Base UI primitives; Radix remains supported but is no longer the default.

sources.title: Material UI — Tailwind CSS v4 integration
sources.claim: MUI's official Tailwind v4 integration requires enableCssLayer, an explicit @layer order putting mui before utilities, and a hand-written @theme inline block mapping every --mui-* variable to a Tailwind theme variable.

sources.title: Tailwind CSS — Theme variables (@theme)
sources.claim: Tailwind 4 theme variables declared with @theme both define a CSS custom property and generate utility classes; plain :root variables do not generate utilities; a theme can be shared across projects as an importable CSS file.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Theming
sources.claim: shadcn/ui theming is plain CSS custom properties in oklch under :root and .dark, exposed to Tailwind via @theme inline, with semantic background/foreground token pairs and a --radius base token.

sources.title: Base UI — Styling handbook
sources.claim: Base UI is unstyled and CSS-agnostic: className (string or state function), data-attributes for state, a style prop, and only layout-oriented CSS variables such as --available-height; it ships no theme object and no dark mode.

sources.title: Mantine — CSS variables and cssVariablesResolver
sources.claim: Mantine generates --mantine-* CSS variables from its JS theme object, and cssVariablesResolver returns { variables, light, dark } to modify them or add custom variables.

sources.title: Material UI — CSS theme variables configuration
sources.claim: MUI's cssVariables mode supports colorSchemeSelector of media (default), class, data, or a custom pattern; cssVarPrefix renames or drops the --mui prefix; InitColorSchemeScript plus suppressHydrationWarning prevent the SSR flash for non-media selectors.

sources.title: InfoQ — Base UI 1.0 released
sources.claim: Base UI 1.0 shipped 11 December 2025 with 35 accessible unstyled components and a package rename to @base-ui/react.

sources.title: MUI blog — 2026 and beyond
sources.claim: MUI has paused Pigment CSS to focus on Base UI, and Material UI v8 is still in the drafting stage as of 2026.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — registry-item.json schema
sources.claim: A shadcn registry item can carry cssVars (theme/light/dark) and raw css rules, and the registry:theme and registry:style item types exist to distribute a design system.

sources.title: shadcn/ui changelog — Rhea (May 2026)
sources.claim: Rhea (May 2026) is a denser shadcn style that adjusts component sizes and gaps directly rather than changing Tailwind's --spacing multiplier, so utilities like p-2 keep a stable meaning.

sources.title: Mantine — Colors, tuples and virtualColor
sources.claim: Mantine brand colors require 10-shade tuples (TypeScript error otherwise); generateColors/colorsTuple synthesise ramps, virtualColor maps one name onto different ramps per color scheme, and primaryShade can differ per scheme.

sources.title: Mantine — Variants, sizes and variantColorResolver
sources.claim: Mantine's theme.variantColorResolver returns { background, hover, color, border } and centrally governs how every color-aware component renders each variant, including new custom variants.

sources.title: Material UI — Theme components (defaultProps, styleOverrides, variants)
sources.claim: MUI theme components expose defaultProps, slot-keyed styleOverrides with nested selectors, and a props-conditional variants array (now preferred over ownerState callbacks); custom variants and colors need TypeScript module augmentation.

sources.title: Tailwind CSS — Dark mode and @custom-variant
sources.claim: Tailwind 4's dark variant is class-based by default and must be redefined with @custom-variant to key off a data attribute.

sources.title: Mantine — Color schemes
sources.claim: Mantine sets data-mantine-color-scheme on <html> (via MantineProvider on the client, ColorSchemeScript pre-hydration on SSR) and persists the choice in the localStorage key mantine-color-scheme.

sources.title: Mantine help — Color scheme flickering (FART)
sources.claim: Mantine documents the SSR flash-of-wrong-theme problem (FART) and states it can only occur in SSR/SSG apps, fixed by ColorSchemeScript.

sources.title: DTCG — Design Tokens Format Module (draft)
sources.claim: The DTCG Design Tokens Format Module uses JSON with $value/$type/$description, .tokens.json files and {group.token} aliases, but the June 2026 draft still carries a do-not-implement preview warning.

sources.title: Style Dictionary — DTCG support
sources.claim: Style Dictionary v4 has first-class DTCG support, using $value/$type/$description, and the DTCG and legacy formats cannot be mixed in one instance.

sources.title: Style Dictionary — Predefined formats
sources.claim: Style Dictionary ships both css/variables (CSS custom properties) and javascript/es6 / javascript/module / TypeScript declaration outputs, so tokens can be emitted as CSS or as a JS object.

sources.title: mui/material-ui#28714 — merging multiple themes
sources.claim: Merging multiple MUI themes requires manual deep-merging; passing multiple arguments to createTheme() is legacy behaviour that may be removed.

sources.title: Material UI — Theme scoping
sources.claim: MUI theme scoping (THEME_ID) exists chiefly to let Material UI coexist with a second Emotion/styled-components-based library, and MUI's own docs advise against running two styling libraries without a strong reason.

sources.title: mui/material-ui#43508 — unable to customize palettes of colorSchemes
sources.claim: Customising the palettes of MUI colorSchemes has open friction reported against the CSS-variables theme API.

sources.title: Mantine — TypeScript guide (theme augmentation)
sources.claim: Mantine typed theme augmentation is a single mantine.d.ts file augmenting MantineThemeOther, MantineThemeColorsOverride (Record<CustomColors, MantineColorsTuple>) and MantineThemeSizesOverride.

sources.title: mantinedev discussion #7459 — Tailwind 4 layer order
sources.claim: Under Tailwind 4, Mantine's default styles take precedence over Tailwind utilities unless the cascade layer order is fixed (theme, base, mantine, components, utilities) — a regression relative to Tailwind 3.
